From 82a5cc783d49b86afd2f60e297ecd85223c39f88 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Konstantin Taranov <kotaranov@microsoft.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Jun 2024 01:16:08 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] RDMA/mana_ib: Ignore optional access flags for MRs

Ignore optional ib_access_flags when an MR is created.

Fixes: 0266a177631d ("RDMA/mana_ib: Add a driver for Microsoft Azure Network Adapter")
Signed-off-by: Konstantin Taranov <kotaranov@microsoft.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/1717575368-14879-1-git-send-email-kotaranov@linux.microsoft.com
Signed-off-by: Leon Romanovsky <leon@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/mr.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/mr.c
index 4f13423ecdbd..887b09dd86e7 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/mr.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/mr.c
@@ -112,6 +112,7 @@ struct ib_mr *mana_ib_reg_user_mr(struct ib_pd *ibpd, u64 start, u64 length,
 		  "start 0x%llx, iova 0x%llx length 0x%llx access_flags 0x%x",
 		  start, iova, length, access_flags);
 
+	access_flags &= ~IB_ACCESS_OPTIONAL;
 	if (access_flags & ~VALID_MR_FLAGS)
 		return ERR_PTR(-EINVAL);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/mr.c`**
- A single line was added to the `mana_ib_reg_user_mr` function:
  ```c
  access_flags &= ~IB_ACCESS_OPTIONAL;
  ```
  This line modifies the `access_flags` variable by clearing the optional access flags when a memory region (MR) is created.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug related to the handling of optional access flags during the creation of memory regions in the Microsoft Azure Network Adapter driver. By ignoring these optional flags, the patch ensures that only valid access flags are considered, which aligns with the intended functionality of the driver as indicated by the fix reference to a previous commit (0266a177631d). This change is crucial for maintaining the integrity of memory region registrations in the RDMA subsystem.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
int access_flags,
...
if (access_flags & ~VALID_MR_FLAGS)
```
Reason:
The `access_flags` variable includes optional access flags that were not intended to be considered when creating a memory region (MR). This can lead to invalid configurations if these optional flags are present, causing errors during MR registration.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
access_flags &= ~IB_ACCESS_OPTIONAL;
if (access_flags & ~VALID_MR_FLAGS)
```
Reason:
The patch explicitly clears the optional access flags from the `access_flags` variable before validating it. This ensures that only valid access flags are considered, preventing potential errors during MR registration.
